Title: 3 Everyday Foods That Are Wearing Down Your Tooth Enamel

Description:
Enamel erosion works differently from a cavity, the ADA notes - acid dissolves the mineral surface directly, and once it's gone, it doesn't grow back. Cola, orange juice, and candy are three everyday culprits, and none of them need to disappear for good - just a change in timing or how you have them.

Watch to find out why, and what to try instead.
